camel_example: aliyun alidns DescribeBatchResultDetail --region cn-hangzhou --Status SUCCESS --TaskId 80000000 --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --Lang en --BatchType DOMAIN_ADD
description_en: Retrieves the details of a batch processing result
description_zh: 查询批量处理结果的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-batch-result-detail --lang en --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --task-id 80000000 --batch-type DOMAIN_ADD --status SUCCESS --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBatchResultDetail

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. The default value is zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The current page number. The default value is 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页设置的大小
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the batch operation. Valid values:

DOMAIN_ADD: Add domain names in batches.

DOMAIN_DEL: Delete domain names in batches.

RR_ADD: Add DNS records in batches.

RR_DEL: Delete DNS records in batches.

If you leave this parameter empty, the results are not filtered by operation type
parameters.help_zh:
批量操作类型。取值：

DOMAIN_ADD：批量添加域名
DOMAIN_DEL：批量删除域名
RR_ADD：批量添加解析
RR_DEL：批量删除解析
为空时不做筛选
parameters.name: batch_type

parameters.help_en: The status of the task. If you do not specify this parameter, the details of tasks in all states are returned
parameters.help_zh: 获取指定状态结果详情，不传入则获取所有
parameters.name: status
